method: Exact clipping of original native inner-disk surfaces. The real outer rim, stands, hub caps and top pointer remain static. The front/back occluded strips are joined only along the measured native cut boundaries; the two inner circumferences are bridged without filling/replacing either disk face. Original geometry vertices remain unmoved. New cap UVs retain neighboring-face interpolation for provenance. Only added cap primitives use color propagated from actual same-side native painted-surface base-color samples through a Delaunay barycentric field; original 3 images and original material are byte/JSON identical. No authored full disk, no image repainting.
colorRepairReason: Original neural geometry has no visible painted surface behind the fused support; directly sampling its occluded UVs produces stationary-wood shadows on the rotor. Per-vertex source triangles, sample RGB and exact interpolation weights are recorded for every added face. The local cap material has no normal map to avoid borrowing unrelated atlas tangent orientation.
limitations: The formerly occluded strip contains an interpolated color field, not unseen original neural paint; a softer color band remains visible in extreme close-up.
Geometry repair and motion inspection do not constitute final registry approval.
